input.quote: 10.5 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of New York applicable to contracts made and to be performed exclusively in that State without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
input.rationale: The choice of law (New York) matches our preferred position, and no arbitration provision appears anywhere in the Agreement. However, the clause contains no forum selection, leaving venue open and creating risk that disputes are litigated in an unaccepted or foreign forum. We added a single sentence conferring exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County, keeping the existing sentence intact.

ops.oldText: without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
ops.newText: without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws. Each Party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York for any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Agreement, and waives any objection to venue in such courts.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] New York law is acceptable to us, but the clause is silent on forum, so we have added exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County to avoid disputes being pulled into another (or foreign) forum. We can accept Delaware, California or England and Wales courts as a fallback if HDI prefers.
proposal.summary: Add exclusive New York County court venue to the governing law clause.
